memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared. Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him." - Exodus 23:20-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Israel faces a long and dangerous journey to the promised land, God gives a wonderful assurance: He is sending an angel ahead of them to guard them along the way and to lead them to the place He has prepared. They would not walk alone or find their own way. God Himself would go before them, protecting and guiding every step. And this messenger carried God's own Name and authority, so His voice was to be heeded carefully.

What comfort this holds. Notice that God had already prepared the destination — "the place I have prepared." He was not making it up as He went. He knew exactly where He was leading His people, and He provided guidance and protection for the road ahead. The journey was uncertain to them, but never to Him.

We too are on a journey through unknown terrain, and God has not left us to find our own way. He goes before us, He guides us, and He has prepared a place for us. In fact, Jesus told His followers those very words: "I am going there to prepare a place for you" (John 14:2-3). And He has given us His own Spirit to guide us and His voice to follow. Whatever unknown road lies ahead of you, take heart: the God who prepared your destination is already walking the path before you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Do I trust that God goes before me and has prepared my way, even when the road is unknown?
Am I paying attention and listening to His guidance?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You go before me and have prepared a place for me. Help me trust Your guidance on the unknown road ahead and listen carefully to Your voice. Amen.
